name: Hilter am Teutoburger Wald (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hilter am Teutoburger Wald (three green firs on yellow above a yellow half wheel on black).
history: The arms, designed by Hans-Heinrich Reclam, were granted by the Regierungspräsident in Osnabrück in 1977; the wheel recalls the former prince-bishopric of Osnabrück.

features.role: Hilter arms — firs and half wheel
